groups.name: math-zone-spacing
groups.description: A binary operator in a zone changes its glyph only: the author's whitespace is kept as written, nothing breaking or non-breaking is introduced. A unary minus is the glued form: U+2212 binds to a number, letter or opening bracket by its line-break class, and a word joiner binds it to a currency sign. Language-free
